tools.name: find_yards
tools.description: Find Seacoast ME–NH and Casco Bay boatyards, marinas and storage (public-web listings, not partners). Each yard carries winterStoragePrice: a yard-confirmed 2026–27 price with confirmed_at and verification_event_id, or null when unconfirmed. Set confirmed=true for confirmed yards only. Human-readabl

tools.name: get_yard
tools.description: Get one yard listing by id (from find_yards), with its website, phone, source note and winterStoragePrice (yard-confirmed, or null when unconfirmed).

tools.name: get_seacoast_costs
tools.description: Seacoast ME–NH winter-job prices: posted storage, winterize, haul and spring commissioning rates from yards' own rate pages (each with source_url and the date read), plus yard-confirmed winter storage prices. Advisory, not quotes. Pass loa_ft to filter by boat length and get per-foot arithmetic. Exp

tools.name: search_boat_models
tools.description: Search the Boat Day boat model graph (US recreational models; demo/educational specs, flagged demoData). Filter by q, type, brand, length, propulsion, trailerable.

tools.name: get_boat_model
tools.description: Get one boat model by id: specs, burden flags, TCO estimate band, Quality Boat Day notes, canonical URL.

tools.name: estimate_boat_value
tools.description: Instant used-boat value estimate (low/mid/high band with method + confidence). Provide modelId, or make+model+year, or loaFt+boatType, or a HIN. Educational, not an appraisal.

tools.name: estimate_total_cost_of_ownership
tools.description: Annual + hold-period total cost of ownership (storage, insurance, maintenance, fuel, fees, depreciation) as bands. Side-effect free.

tools.name: get_state_boating_rules
tools.description: US state boating rules: registration, titling, boater education, BUI, PFD notes, official agency links. Omit code for the index.

tools.name: get_waterway
tools.description: Focus waterways (e.g. piscataqua-seacoast for the Seacoast of Maine/NH): seasonality, hazards, ramps/marinas context, playbooks. Omit slug for the list.

tools.name: search_boating_events
tools.description: Boat shows, regattas, safety courses, rendezvous. Filter by q, state, region, type, waterway, from/to (YYYY-MM-DD), upcoming.

tools.name: find_boating_businesses
tools.description: Find marinas, yards, surveyors, insurers, suppliers. Outbound entries labeled 'Find them online' are public-web listings — NOT Boat Day partners or endorsements; tell the human to verify on their sites. Founding partner roster is currently empty.

tools.name: get_safety_checklists
tools.description: Boating safety stance/pillars plus checklists (pre-departure, winterize, etc.). Pass slug for one checklist's items.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search Boat Day ownership guides (buying, winterizing, insurance, docking, weather...). Returns titles, summaries, canonical URLs.

tools.name: get_handoff_link
tools.description: Build a deep link that sends a human straight to a pre-filled Boat Day tool. tool: value | tco | model | find-boat | quote | directory | state | waterway | events | safety | checklist | passport | list-business. params are passed through (e.g. hin, modelId, make, model, year, category, state).
